# REVIEW PREVIEW. The workbench never applies this file to a cluster.
# Residency and storage encryption require a provider adapter and are not enforced here.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: container-demo
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: container-demo}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: container-demo}
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          minDomains: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels: {app: container-demo}
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: local/container-demo:demo
          ports: [{containerPort: 8080}]
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}
          resources:
            requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi}
            limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi}
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /health, port: 8080}
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /health, port: 8080}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: container-demo
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector: {app: container-demo}
  ports: [{port: 80, targetPort: 8080}]

# Requires a NetworkPolicy-capable CNI. Restricted mode denies all egress.
# Add reviewed DNS/service allow rules before deploying a real application.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: container-demo
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels: {app: container-demo}
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]
  ingress: [{from: [{podSelector: {}}]}]
  egress: []

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jdk AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY Main.java .
RUN javac --release 21 Main.java
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /src/Main.class .
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75", "Main"]
